questions.question: Which historic movement joined forces with French student demonstrations over climbing fuel costs across France?
questions.explanation: Activists associated with the yellow vests took to the streets nationwide over fuel prices and linked up with student marches.
questions.context: 2026 European unrest > 2026 French fuel protests: Yellow vests activists hold mass demonstrations across France against rising fuel prices and join the student protests.

questions.question: Which disease control initiative did Equatorial Guinea announce it would expand beyond Bioko Island to its mainland and Annobón?
questions.explanation: Equatorial Guinea is broadening its anti-malaria campaign across the rest of the nation following successful suppression of the illness on Bioko.
questions.context: Equatorial Guinea announces that it will expand its program against malaria to the mainland and Annobón. The program has already heavily reduced malaria cases on Bioko Island.

questions.story: Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present) > Yemeni civil war > Egypt–Saudi Arabia relations, Houthi–Saudi conflict
questions.question: Which neighbouring country did Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi promise to defend and support if called upon?
questions.explanation: President El-Sisi affirmed Egypt's readiness to assist and safeguard Saudi Arabia should the nation desire aid.
questions.context: Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present) > Yemeni civil war > Egypt–Saudi Arabia relations, Houthi–Saudi conflict: Egyptian president Abdel Fattah El-Sisi states that Egypt will take all necessary steps to protect and defend Saudi Arabia should the latter so desire.

questions.question: In a historic Senate election in Czechia, which governing political movement finished in third place after the coalition failed to win any seats?
questions.explanation: Prime Minister Andrej Babiš's ANO 2011 secured third position as opposition parties took 22 of the 27 available senatorial seats.
questions.context: 2026 Czech Senate election: In Czechia, opposition parties win 22 of the contested 27 seats in the Senate. The lead party of prime minister Andrej Babiš's government, ANO 2011, comes in third place. The election is the first time in the country's history where governing parties did not win a single seat in a senatorial election.

questions.question: Vietnam signed a comprehensive free trade agreement eliminating tariffs with which regional trading bloc?
questions.explanation: The newly signed pact between Vietnam and the European Free Trade Association covers agricultural, industrial, and fisheries trade.
questions.context: Free trade agreements of Vietnam: Vietnam signs a free trade agreement with the European Free Trade Association (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, and Switzerland) that reduces or eliminates tariffs on industrial, agricultural, and fish products and covers services, intellectual property, and sustainable development.
